topics.topic: When EffectApproval records must be created/requested, including resend/not_applied draft-write cases and whether they use the normal request/decision flow
questions: Exactly for which effect classes/situations is an EffectApproval record created/requested?
Which product action creates that fresh approval for a `draft-write` resend (normally no per-effect approval), and is it modeled as a normal EffectApproval request/decision cycle?

quotes:
At run time each `state-transition`, `external-effect` and
`destructive` node stops for the owner's approval of the exact operation, target
and input, unless the owner granted that exact flow version a standing approval
for that node; `destructive` never takes a grant.

An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh
approval, even where a standing approval exists.

Written for every send of
an operation whose effect class is not `read`, `draft-write` included; a `read`
send writes none, since nothing leaves the service changed (State 2, A08 rule 4,
A10 rule 6).
judgement.why: The texts already define when per-effect approval is required (only those effect classes, plus any resend after `not_applied`) and that normal `draft-write` sends proceed under activation rather than per-effect approval.

topics.topic: Authorization source for effect resend: always require fresh owner approval vs allow active standing grant
questions: When an effect is sent again, is a fresh owner approval always required, or can an active standing grant authorize the resend?

topics.topic: EffectApproval multiplicity rules per run/node/map (multiple approved history and concurrent open requests)
questions: What cardinality constraints apply to approvals at the same run/node/map (especially for retries/resends): can multiple historical `approved` records coexist, and can more than one `requested` approval be open at once?

topics.topic: How duplicate code submissions are handled: new submission with admission/activation vs pure lookup of existing implementation
questions: If an agent submits code equal to an existing implementation, is that still a new submission event that must run admission over the current corpus (and possibly create a new Activation), or is it only a lookup returning the existing implementation with no admission/activation change?

topics.topic: Run termination behavior after an owner refuses an effect: immediate hard stop vs allow in-flight work to finish
questions: If the owner refuses one effect while other branches are runnable or in progress, does the kernel stop all further scheduling immediately (hard terminal), or may in-progress node attempts finish before the run is marked ended?

topics.topic: Stable identity/reference model for NodeExecution in cross-record links (e.g., captured_from)
questions: What is the stable reference target for `captured_from` and other cross-record links to a NodeExecution: a dedicated node-execution identifier, or a composite of fields, or embedded full facts?

topics.topic: StandingGrant re-grant semantics after revocation: create new entity vs reactivate/update old one
questions: If the owner grants again after a prior grant for that node/version was revoked, does the kernel create a new StandingGrant entity or reactivate/update the revoked one?

topics.topic: Whether kernel-generated persisted records must explicitly store Actor(kind=kernel)
questions: Must every persisted record that is created by automatic kernel steps include an explicit Actor value (`kind: kernel`), or is the record type itself considered sufficient to satisfy "name it as the actor"?

topics.topic: Whether returning an older matching contract version changes the slot’s current contract version
questions: When a request names a slot and matches an older (non-current) contract version exactly, does returning that existing version change which contract version is considered current for the slot?
